info.title: Insolvia API
info.description:
The API behind the Insolvia app and the client portal.

**Signing in.** A route that needs a caller takes a Cognito access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a firm user's (`staff`) or a portal client's (`client`), as the route says. Pick the scheme under Authentication below and paste the token to try a route.

**Permissions.** A staff route that needs more than membership of the firm lists them under `x-insolvia-permissions`, as `feature:level`. A firm's administrators hold every permission.

**Errors.** Every refusal is a JSON `ErrorBody`: `error` is a stable code to branch on, `message` is for people, and a validation error names the `fields` at fault.

**Absent, not null.** A member a schema does not require is left out when it is unset, never sent as `null`.

**Times** are ISO 8601 in UTC; court dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.

post.summary: Open a case for one client, or two filing jointly
post.description:
The firm is the caller's, never the body's. The caller is linked to the
case, and each client's identity is copied to its debtor (Debtor 1,
then Debtor 2) in the same write. An unknown, archived or merged client
is a 400 on `clientIds`.

get.description:

page's `nextCursor`), `archived` (`true` lists the archived
cases instead of the working list). Not access-logged: the log is keyed
by case, and a list touches none in particular.

A status move is recorded as a lifecycle event; a move off the lifecycle
is a 409, and reaching `filed` needs `filedAt` and
`caseNumber`. A filed case's chapter changes only by a conversion
(409). A change to the petition date, the § 341 date or the chapter
regenerates the case's deadlines.

The candidate is compare-and-swapped BEFORE the record is written; a
second reviewer gets a 409 and nothing is written. A rejection answers
the candidate alone; an acceptance also the record it wrote — a case
record, or for a client's answer about a debtor, that debtor.

harness or the client portal, with everything a reviewer needs to verify
it. Optional members are absent, never null.

chapter.description: A new chapter; a filed case's chapter changes only by a conversion (409).

court.description: A new court's CM/ECF code, sent with string? CaseChanges.Division.

division.description: A new division's code, sent with string? CaseChanges.Court.

oneOf.description: A status move — a lifecycle event; a move off the lifecycle is a 409.

oneOf.description: Form 106C line 1's election.

filedAt.description: The petition date; null clears it.

judge.description: The judge's name; null clears it.

trustee.description: The trustee's name; null clears it.

CaseChanges.description:
Editing a case (`PATCH /v1/cases/{caseId}`): only the keys sent
change, and a body with none is a 400. The petition date, the § 341 date
and the four docket facts may be cleared — an explicit null, which
bool CaseChanges.Names(string member) tells apart from a key not sent.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

CaseList.description: One page of the cases the caller may see, newest first.

CasePublicStatus.description:
What a CLIENT may read of their case: its chapter and its stage — and
nothing else (ADR 0023 decision 4; from `clients.py`). A PROJECTION,
not a Case: the store method that produces it takes the
ClientAccessor and returns this type, so no portal route
holds a case to leak a district, a date or a pin from.
CaseStatus CasePublicStatus.Stage is the lifecycle status, not the overview's computed spine.

CaseStatus.description:
THE LIFECYCLE, AS DATA (issue 14.3 / #355; Python's `STATUSES`), in
the order a matter moves through it. A case STARTS at intake — there is no
prospect case.

readyToFile.description: Whether the completeness gate has no problems.

problems.description: The gate's problems — the same packet assembly runs.

CaseSummaryView.description: What a case is worth, what it owes, and whether it could be filed.

description.description: A new description, or null to clear.

dueDate.description: A new due date, or null to clear.

assigneeSubject.description: A new assignee, or null to unassign.

formSeries.description: A new form anchor, or null to clear.

CaseTaskChanges.description:

and a body with none is a 400. A nullable member sent as null clears it
(bool CaseTaskChanges.Names(string member) tells that apart from a key not sent);
string? CaseTaskChanges.Subject can be replaced, never cleared.

assigneeSubject.description: An active user of the caller's firm.

formSeries.description: The short form key to anchor it to (`b106d`).

is required; `done` is never accepted here — every task starts not-done.

checklist dedupes by title, so the second could never be requested.

fields.description: For a validation error: each field at fault, by name, and what is wrong with it.

Every refusal's body: the error's code, and either a message or — for a
validation error — the fields at fault, each with what is wrong with it.

EventDismissal.description: Dismiss or restore an event (`PATCH …/events/{eventId}`). The member must be alone: a client that meant PUT finds out rather than losing its edits.

start.description: All-day: `YYYY-MM-DD`. Otherwise an RFC 3339 instant with an offset (or Z).

end.description: As `start`; absent means the start day (all-day) or an hour after the start.

allDay.description: Whether the span is whole days; absent means "a bare date in `start` is all-day".

attendees.description: Firm users, by subject; each must be a member of the caller's firm.

EventRequest.description:
An event as written (`POST` or `PUT` on `…/events`), whole.
`end` defaults to `start` (all-day) or an hour later (timed);
`allDay` defaults to whether `start` is a bare date. A span over
int CalendarEvents.MaxEventSpanDays days is refused.

end.description: As `start`; an all-day end is inclusive.

allDay.description: Whether the span is whole days.

attendees.description: The firm users attending, by subject, in the order given.

generated.description: Whether the deadline engine made it. A generated deadline cannot be edited or deleted, only dismissed.

dismissed.description: Whether someone dismissed it; survives regeneration.

createdBy.description: Who made it: a subject, or the deadline engine's actor.

createdAt.description: When it was made, ISO 8601 UTC.

updatedAt.description: When it was last written, ISO 8601 UTC.

caseId.description: The case; absent for a firm event.

ruleId.description: The deadline rule that generated it; absent for a hand-made event.

EventView.description:
A calendar event, a case's or the firm's own. `allDay` decides how
`start` and `end` read.

asOf.description: The date the law is resolved as of, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

election.description: 106C line 1: the federal or the state scheme.

entries.description: Every claimable statute of the effective scheme and what is left under it.

limits.description: The statutory caps that apply across entries.

lookbacks.description: The § 522 look-back windows as calendar dates.

assets.description: Each asset's equity and what the claims on it cover.

warnings.description: What a preparer should check, for a person.

problems.description: What is missing, for a person.

ExemptionAnalysisView.description:
The Schedule C workbench: which exemption scheme applies, what each
statute has left, and what the claims on each asset cover. Money is a
decimal string to the cent; a figure that cannot be derived yet is null.

currentValue.description: Its value; null when not entered.

netEquity.description: Value less liens; null without a value.

unexempt.description: Equity left unprotected; null without a value.

homesteadCap.description: The § 522(p) cap applied; null when none.

capApplied.description: Whether the cap cut the claim.

claims.description: The exemption records on the asset.

suggestions.description: What each statute could still protect on this asset, by entry id.

ExemptionAssetView.description: One asset's equity and what the claims on it cover.

ExemptionBody.description:
The claimed exemption — 106C, one row per exemption asserted on an asset
(from `exemption_claims.py`). decimal? ExemptionBody.Amount and
bool? ExemptionBody.ClaimsFullFmv are mutually exclusive, but that is a
completeness fact, not a shape rule. string? ExemptionBody.AssetId is unchecked
here (progressive intake). The property description and value 106C prints
are the asset's, copied at projection time, never stored here.

ExemptionCategory.description: What kind of property an exemption protects — the analyzer's axis.

statuteCitation.description: The statute it cites; null when not entered.

amount.description: The amount entered; null when not entered.

claimsFullFmv.description: Whether it claims 100% of fair market value.

acquiredWithin1215Days.description: Whether the interest was acquired inside § 522(p)'s window.

knownStatute.description: Whether the citation is in the effective scheme.

ExemptionClaimView.description: One exemption record on an asset, and what it counts as.

stored.description: The answer the case stores; null when unanswered.

effective.description: The answer in effect (the state's when it opted out).

state.description: The state whose law applies; null when unknown.

optedOut.description: Whether that state opted out of the federal scheme; null when unknown.

optOutCitation.description: The opt-out statute; null when none.

options.description: The answers the case may store.

ExemptionElectionView.description: 106C line 1 as resolved for this case.

entryId.description: The statute's id in the scheme.

category.description: What kind of property it covers.

unlimited.description: Whether it has no dollar limit.

limit.description: Its limit for this case; null when unlimited or not derivable.

perItemAmount.description: A per-item cap; null when none.

carryover.description: Wildcard carried over into it; null when none applies.

available.description: Left to claim; null when unlimited or not derivable.

notes.description: The scheme's notes on it; empty when none.

ExemptionEntryView.description: One claimable statute and what this case has left under it.

ExemptionLookbacksView.description: The § 522 look-back windows: each the first day the rule reaches back to.

ExpenseBody.description: One 106J expense line, in its household.

externalUrl.description: A link to it; absent when none.

ExternalRefView.description: Where an MCP harness sourced a candidate.

basis.description: What an approval would be bound to, computed now.

approval.description: The case's current approval (voided if the filing set changed); absent when none.

filing.description: The filing run the approval started; absent before a worker claimed it.

FilingApprovalState.description:
A case's filing approval as it stands: what would be approved now, and —
once one exists — the approval and the filing run it started.

filingId.description: The filing run it is for.

status.description: What it is now: `pending`, `consumed`, `voided`, or `expired` (pending past `expiresAt`).

digest.description: The basis digest the attorney approved.

expiresAt.description: When it can no longer be consumed, ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds.

credentialId.description: The CM/ECF credential it files with.

consumedAt.description: When the filing worker consumed it; absent until then.

voidedAt.description: When it was voided; absent unless voided.

FilingApprovalView.description: What a client sees of an attorney's approval to file.

digest.description: The basis digest shown; a mismatch is refused.

credentialId.description: The CM/ECF credential to file with; absent for the caller's only one.

FilingApproveRequest.description:
An attorney's approval (`POST /v1/cases/{caseId}/filing-approval`):
the digest of the basis as shown.

currentVersion.description: The version a signature must be over to be current.

current.description: Whether the caller's signature is over the current version.

oneOf.description: The signature on record; null when the caller never signed or withdrew.

FilingAuthorizationView.description:
The caller's written authorization to file: the signature on record (in
force or stale), and the text a new signature would be over.

link.description: Where to do it; absent when nowhere in particular.

FilingChecklistItemView.description: One step of the hand-off checklist.

FilingCheckView.description: One district check of a document.

divisionName.description: The division; absent when the case names none.

FilingCourtView.description: The court a case files in.

courts.description: The court codes the attorney e-files in with it.

status.description: Always `active` while it exists: revoking destroys it.

createdAt.description: When it was enrolled, ISO 8601 UTC with microseconds.

updatedAt.description: When it was last written, ISO 8601 UTC with microseconds.

FilingCredentialView.description:

ever receives: no password, no authenticator key, no sealed envelope.

fileName.description: The name to file it under.

checks.description: The district's checks against the packet's file.

note.description: A note for the filer; absent when none.

FilingDocumentView.description: One document of the filing set.

login.description: The PACER username: letters, digits and `. _ @ -`, at most 64 characters.

totpSeed.description: The authenticator key PACER showed: base32, at least 16 characters, spaces and case ignored.

courts.description: The court codes the attorney e-files in.

FilingEnrolmentRequest.description:
A CM/ECF credential to enrol (`POST /v1/me/filing-credentials`). The

echoes a submitted value. Its text form is redacted, so it cannot reach a log line.

name.description: Four discrete parts, never one string — the IEPD has no single-string fallback for names.

compensation disclosure — facts about THIS engagement. The balance due is
the difference of the two amounts and is never stored.

oneOf.description: `filed` or `not_filed`.

docketChecked.description: Must be true: the attorney checked the court's docket.

caseNumber.description: The case number on the docket; filed only.

confirmationDocumentId.description: An uploaded confirmation document; filed only.

FilingResolutionRequest.description:

FilingRole.description: A debtor's role on the petition (Python's `FILING_ROLES`).

registryRelease.description: The court registry release it was built from.

The questionnaire as a client's firm configured it: the enabled sections
only, each with the instructions in force and its live questions in order.
Nothing about what is switched off, nothing staff-facing.

repeats.description: Whether a client may give many answers (one per row).

perDebtor.description: Whether the answer is about the answering debtor.

help.description: Help text under the question; absent when none.

PortalQuestionView.description: One question as the portal renders it.

requests.description: The requests, oldest first, each with the client's own uploads against it.

progress.description: Arrived against outstanding; the total excludes waived.

PortalRequestList.description: The document requests a client's firm made of them, and the case's progress.

kind.description: The kind an upload against it is filed under.

description.description: What the client reads under the title; null when none.

uploads.description: The client's own uploads against it.

PortalRequestView.description: A document request as the client reads it in the portal: no case id, no document ids, only their own uploads.

id.description: The section's id — stable; answers hang off it.

instructions.description: The instructions in force: the firm's own, else the default.

document.description: The document, as the client sees it.

requestId.description: The open document request this upload answers.

fileName.description: The file name, at most 255 characters, no path separators or invisible characters.

oneOf.description: The content type the upload will carry.

byteSize.description: The size in bytes, at most 50 MB.

PortalUploadRequest.description:
A client's upload against one of the firm's document requests
(`POST /v1/portal/documents`). The document's kind is the request's.
Every check runs before an upload URL exists.

document.description: The document, as the client sees it.

PortalUploadTicket.description: A client's new upload: the document, and where to PUT its bytes.

method.description: `PUT` for an upload, `GET` for a download.

headers.description: For an upload, the exact headers it was signed for — the bucket refuses anything else; absent for a download.

expiresAt.description: When the URL stops working, ISO 8601 UTC to the millisecond — so a client can tell an expired URL from a refused one.

PresignedRequest.description:
A short-lived presigned request straight to the bucket: the bytes never
pass through the API.

PriorCaseBody.description: B101 line 9: a bankruptcy filed within the last 8 years.

oneOf.description: The stage, or null to leave the funnel; the key itself is required.

ProspectStageRequest.description: Place a prospect in the funnel, or take them out (`PUT …/{clientId}/prospect-stage`).

confirmed_by.description: The person who confirmed the value.

confirmed_at.description: When they confirmed it — a UTC timestamp ending in `Z`.

document_id.description: The document the value was read from.

locator.description: Where on the page: `{document_id, page, region: {x, y, width, height}}`, region in page fractions.

extraction_id.description: The extraction candidate the value was accepted from.

library_creditor_id.description: The library creditor a ProvenanceSource.Library value was copied from. Shape and type only — never validated against the store.

client_id.description: The firm client a ProvenanceSource.Client value was copied from. Shape and type only.

copied_from_case_id.description: The case this value was COPIED FROM (issue 14.3), orthogonal to ProvenanceSource ProvenanceEntry.Source.

ProvenanceEntry.description:
Where one field's value came from. string? ProvenanceEntry.ConfirmedBy and
string? ProvenanceEntry.ConfirmedAt are one act — a human said "yes, that is right"
at a moment — and exactly what accepting an extraction candidate writes.

ProvenanceSource.description:
Who supplied a value. Order is Python's `SOURCES` tuple — it is the
order the "Source must be one of …" message lists them in.

QuestionnaireRequest.description:

every catalogue section named exactly once — a whole-record save.

enabled.description: Whether clients see it; an unswitchable section must be true.

instructions.description: The firm's instructions; absent, or the default text, means the default.

id.description: The section's id; ids are a contract and never renamed.

covers.description: What the section covers, for a person.

switchable.description: Whether the firm may switch it off; `personal_information` never.

instructions.description: The firm's own instructions; null for the default.

defaultInstructions.description: The instructions shipped with the section.

QuestionnaireSectionView.description: One questionnaire section with the firm's choice applied.

isDefault.description: True when the firm has saved nothing and reads the defaults.

updatedAt.description: Last saved, ISO 8601 UTC to the microsecond; null while default.

updatedBy.description: The subject who last saved it; null while default.

sections.description: Every section, in the questionnaire's order.

QuestionnaireView.description:
The firm's client-questionnaire config as staff read it (`questionnaire_json`):
every section, switched off or not, with the firm's instructions beside the default.

RelatedCaseBody.description: B101 line 10: a pending case by a spouse, partner, or affiliate.

ResolutionOutcome.description: What the court's docket shows, as the attorney resolved it (Python's `ResolutionOutcome`).

message.description: What went wrong, for a person.

docketCheckedAt.description: When the attorney checked the docket, ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds.

caseNumber.description: The case number on the docket; absent unless filed.

filedAt.description: The petition date, `yyyy-MM-dd`; absent unless filed.

confirmationDocumentId.description: The uploaded confirmation document; absent when none.

text.description: The question, as the client saw it.

ReviewQuestionView.description: The question a client's answer answers.

How the plan treats one secured claim: cure-and-maintain (arrearage cured,
optional conduit maintenance), cramdown (paid to the collateral's value)
or surrender (nothing through the plan). decimal? SecuredTreatment.MonthlyPayment
fixes the equal monthly payment; absent, the calculator amortises.

oneOf.description: The caller's signature block, whole; null removes it.

SelfChanges.description:
The caller's change to themselves (`PATCH /v1/me`): their name
(either half alone) and their signature block. Everything else on the row
is somebody else's statement about the member and is not read.

address.description: The address on the block; an empty one when none was given.

SignatureBlock.description:
An attorney's standing signature block (issue #360). The member names and
limits are a `filingProfessional` body's, so "use firm default" copies
it with no mapping. The name is not here — it is the firm user's own.

payload.description:
One answer's question-specific shape, named by its `entryType`. Not
abstract on purpose: a payload without an `entryType` reads as this
base record, which SofaEntryBody refuses by name, rather
than failing the whole read.

SofaEntryBody.description: One Form 107 entry: its answer, whose `entryType` names the question.

SofaPayload.description:
One answer's question-specific shape, named by its `entryType`. Not
abstract on purpose: a payload without an `entryType` reads as this
base record, which SofaEntryBody refuses by name, rather
than failing the whole read.

address.description:
Structured parts AND a raw fallback (the IEPD's free-text form, for a
creditor block that will not parse). string? Address.County is B101 line 5's box.
string? Address.PostalCode is `postalCode` under every serializer, the
stored rows' snake_case one included (ADR 0032).

SoleProprietorshipBody.description: B101 line 12: a business the debtor operates as a sole proprietor.

SpecialCircumstanceItem.description: One B122C-2 line-43 row: a special circumstance and its monthly amount.

householdSize.description: The household size; null when unknown.

jurisdictionSource.description: Where the state and county came from.

problems.description: What could not resolve, for a person.

StandardsView.description:
The IRS National and Local Standards for the case's jurisdiction and
household. Money is a decimal string; a figure that could not resolve is
null, so the screen knows which box to label missing.

changedAt.description: When it was recorded, ISO 8601 UTC with microseconds.

changedBy.description: The subject who made it, or the filing worker.

oneOf.description: The status before.
The status after.

filingId.description: The electronic filing that made the move; absent otherwise.

StatusChangeView.description:
One status move, in the shape the app's `getCaseStatusHistory` reads:
the lifecycle history's status events only — a conversion or a ruling is
not a status move.

StepPayment.description: From int? StepPayment.StartMonth on (1-based, inclusive) the monthly payment is decimal? StepPayment.MonthlyPayment.

TaskList.description: Tasks, in the order the route states.

overdue.description: Derived: not done and due before today (UTC).

createdAt.description: When it was created, ISO 8601 UTC.

updatedAt.description: When it was last written, ISO 8601 UTC.

createdBy.description: Who created it, by subject. An audit fact; it grants nothing.

dueDate.description: When it is due, `YYYY-MM-DD`; absent when undated.

assigneeSubject.description: The firm user it is assigned to; absent when unassigned.

formSeries.description: The short form key it is anchored to (`b106d`); absent when none.

completedAt.description: When it was marked done, ISO 8601 UTC; absent while not done.

kind.description: SSN or ITIN — the number must be that kind.

What a write carries. EXACTLY ONE of string? TaxIdInput.Value (nine digits,
freshly typed, dashes allowed) and string? TaxIdInput.LastFour (the client
echoing the view it was given: "keep what is stored") is set.

TaxIdKind.description: Which kind of taxpayer number (Python's `TAX_ID_KINDS`). The first digit decides it.

TaxIdView.description: A stored tax id as it may leave the server: its kind and last four, never the number.

UnsubscribeReceipt.description: The one answer to a valid unsubscribe token.

token.description: The signed token from the email's unsubscribe link.

x-amz-tagging.description: The unconfirmed-upload tag; the bucket reaps a tagged object after a day.

subject.description: The colleague's sign-in subject, their id.

displayName.description: The two halves composed, the one way a name reads.

oneOf.description: Their standing signature block, its unanswered fields absent; null when none.

A colleague as anyone in the firm may see them (`firm_user_summary_json`):
a name, a job title and the signature block — no email, no permissions, no status.

subject.description: The member's sign-in subject, their id.

firstName.description: Their first name; `""` when never recorded.

lastName.description: Their last name; `""` when never recorded.

displayName.description: The two halves composed, the one way a name reads.

role.description: Their job title; it sets the default permissions only.

accessAllCases.description: Whether they see every case, not only those they are on.

permissions.description: The stored level for each feature that has one.

status.description: Whether the membership is active or disabled.

createdAt.description: Added, ISO 8601 UTC to the millisecond.

updatedAt.description: Last changed, ISO 8601 UTC to the millisecond.

oneOf.description: Their standing signature block, its unanswered fields absent; null when none.

UserView.description:
A firm member's whole record (`firm_user_json`), for the firm's
administrators. `permissions` is the STORED map, not the effective one.

submittedAt.description: When it was stored, ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds.

host.description: The marketing host the form was sent from.

A waitlist sign-up (`POST /v1/waitlist`): the marketing form's caps,
and the DNS name limit for the host the marketing action sends. Unknown
keys are ignored — the form's honeypot is checked in its action and never
reaches this API.
